## Validation and limitations

- Relative recall was **15/15 (100%)** on the development set and **9/9 (100%)** on the held-out set. The held-out records were screened after the strategy was fixed; both sets came from the same focused pilot search, so this is not absolute sensitivity.
- Category probes screened 30 records per draw. Their samples found no relevant member-only records, but both category blocks later changed after their standard probe budgets were exhausted. The internal critic accepted the stale-probe status as a documented risk.
- I assumed “farm animals” means terrestrial agricultural animals, including livestock and poultry; farmed aquatic species are excluded. Confirm that scope against your protocol.
- The critic was reviewed in the same context. This is internal PRESS-structured review, not PRESS peer review. An information specialist should peer-review the strategy before use.
